function: Jointly designs BS beamformers and IRS phase shifts to maximize long-term sum-rate under bounded CSI errors and QoS constraints (p. 6).
system: Downlink MISO-NOMA: BS with T=2-4 antennas serving N=T single-antenna UEs via passive reflecting IRS of M=16-128 elements; carrier frequency not stated (p. 3, p. 12).
method: TD3 actor-critic deep reinforcement learning with replay buffer; actions normalized to meet power and unit-modulus constraints (p. 7, p. 8, p. 9).
data_channel: Custom simulation: BS-IRS and IRS-UE Rician (K=1), direct link Rayleigh, distance-based path loss; cell radius 200 m; no 3GPP or measured data (p. 11, p. 12).
test_conditions: Fixed: same channels in training and testing, random bounded CSI errors. Dynamic: 10 training channels, 250 random test channels, same distance range (p. 12, p. 14).
baselines: Learned: DDPG agent. Non-learned: SDP-based IRS plus power minimization (Baseline 1), zero-forcing with fixed power and SDP IRS (Baseline 2), random design (Baseline 3) (p. 11).
metrics: System sum-rate (b/s/Hz), robustness score (%), individual user rates, training reward convergence, training time (p. 12 to p. 15).
complexity: Actor inference worst-case O(H*max(H,|s|)) with H hidden neurons, |s| state size; offline training 0.17 to 14.15 h on four machines (Table 1, p. 10).
q1_support: p. 11: "modelled by Rician and Rayleigh fading for the reflected and direct channels". Custom simulator with distance-based path loss; no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, DeepMIMO or measured channel is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 12: "changes during both training and testing". The 250 test channels (p. 14) come from the same distance range as training; a separate agent is trained per N, T, M; Figs. 12 and 18 only sweep the target rate on the same channels.
q3_support: p. 11: "DDPG is included as a DRL benchmark to showcase the performance gain of the proposed TD3-based design"; p. 11: "This benchmark scheme is based on SDP." Both are compared on sum-rate in Figs. 8-10 (p. 13).
q4_support: p. 10: "the worst-case run-time for the proposed algorithm scales linearly with the system parameters for a fixed number of neurons"
q5_support: p. 14: "we use a total of 250 randomly generated channels". Channels are self-simulated; no code or data link, and no public channel dataset, appear anywhere in the paper.
notes: Area 3: the TD3 agent sets BS beamformers and IRS phases jointly. DDPG counted as the learned baseline (standard agent, also used for the same problem in earlier work [18], p. 2), although TD3 is an enhanced DDPG. q2 borderline: the text on p. 13 and p. 15 tests target rates above the training Rmin (1.5 vs 1 b/s/Hz; 0.5 vs 0.3 b/s/Hz), a threshold sweep on the same channels, not counted as a new scenario; reviewer may confirm.
